authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.mission: Organic publishing, comments/DM community, verified FAQ fast path, sensitive escalation, lead handoff and analytics, using W07 generic executor and W08 provider adapters.

tasks.title: W11-00 - Social/Community Coordination & Ownership Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate W05-W10 outputs and provider capabilities.
2. Freeze ownership between W11 domain logic, W08 provider adapters and W07 executor.
3. Define publication/community intent contracts, moderation/escalation rules and analytics outcomes.
4. Define safe staging and no-real-side-effect test strategy.
5. Create risk/premortem for duplicate posts, wrong account, harmful replies, consent/lead leakage and ambiguous publication state.
tasks.ownership: W11 social/community domain packages and governance.
tasks.forbidden: Do not duplicate Instagram transport/executor primitives owned by W08/W07.

tasks.title: W11-A - Organic Publication Contracts & Scheduling
actions: 1. Define post/story/reel/publication intents and lifecycle states.
2. Model scheduled time, media references, account/tenant binding, idempotency and cancellation.
3. Use W03 timers/events for scheduling and W07 for writes.
4. Support draft/prepare/paused-safe states where relevant.
5. Add time/replay/cancel tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not perform direct Meta/Instagram writes.

tasks.title: W11-B - Publication Provider Integration & Reconciliation
actions: 1. Compose W11 publication intents with W08 Instagram/Meta adapters through W07.
2. Implement provider readback/reconciliation for create/publish ambiguity.
3. Prevent duplicate publication on timeout/replay.
4. Record provider post IDs as external references only.
5. Test late readback, missing media, token expiry and wrong account.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create a second generic executor.

tasks.title: W11-C - Comments/DM Ingestion & Conversation Routing
actions: 1. Ingest comments/DM events idempotently.
2. Bind conversation/user/provider references to W10 lifecycle.
3. Classify intent/risk/modality and route deterministic vs governed paths.
4. Handle duplicates, edits/deletes and pagination/reconnect safely.
5. Add tenant/account isolation tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not let inbound content directly execute tools/side effects.

tasks.title: W11-D - Verified FAQ / Fact Fast Path
actions: 1. Implement verified fact lookup for hours/location/common FAQ using W06 context/cache/templates.
2. Require freshness/provenance and invalidate on source change.
3. Return deterministic/template answer when confidence/facts suffice.
4. Escalate conflicts or stale facts.
5. Benchmark latency/cost improvement.
tasks.forbidden: Cache/template match is not authority for external actions.

tasks.title: W11-E - Sensitive Escalation, Moderation & Response Planning
actions: 1. Classify complaint/refund/safety/legal/sensitive cases for Governed Lane/human escalation.
2. Use W05 reasoning only when needed and preserve policy/consent constraints.
3. Generate response candidates without direct send authority.
4. Define moderation/hide/delete intents as governed side effects.
5. Add adversarial/prompt-injection/toxic-content tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not auto-send sensitive responses based only on confidence.

tasks.title: W11-F - Lead Handoff to W10
actions: 1. Detect lead signals in comments/DMs using explicit provenance.
2. Create idempotent W10 lead/conversation handoff.
3. Preserve consent/purpose and source channel/account.
4. Prevent duplicate lead creation across repeated provider events.
5. Add opt-out and wrong-tenant tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create competing CRM state inside W11.

tasks.title: W11-G - Organic/Community Analytics
actions: 1. Build read models for publication/community outcomes and operational metrics.
2. Separate provider observations from Aurora business outcomes.
3. Link correlation/evidence to publication/reply/lead handoff.
4. Expose data suitable for W17 telemetry and W18 evals.
5. Add stale/partial provider analytics tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not make analytics a source of authority.

tasks.title: W11-H - Social E2E Validation
actions: 1. Run staged publication, duplicate timeout/reconciliation, inbound FAQ, sensitive escalation and lead-handoff scenarios.
2. Prove all writes pass W07/current Policy/Authority.
3. Run provider failure/rate limit and event replay stress.
4. Run four Risk Gates and exact-head CI.
5. Publish W11 acceptance/evidence.
tasks.forbidden: No unsafe real production side effect in acceptance unless explicitly authorized by later staging governance.
